title: Wonder Rice Smoothing Toner
description: A multi-use, value-sized toner that works wonders? Meet our Wonder Rice Smoothing Toner, a 5 in 1 multi-toner that works to clarify and hydrate the skin with fermented rice filtrate! Formulated with fruit extracts and fermented rice filtrate, our gentle, hypoallergenic toner provides daily care that helps condition and soften skin texture, give soothing hydration, and detoxify impurities for brighter, clearer skin. Why It's Good Our hypoallergenic, alcohol-free, and irritant-free toner is formulated with ingredients that are all rated EWG Green, making this gentle formula perfect to use on all skin types. The highly absorptive fermented rice filtrate works to penetrate deep into the skin for longer-lasting hydration and more transformative results. Natural fruit extracts also help to naturally exfoliate the skin so skin feels smoother and more hydrated with each use. Key Ingredients Fermented Rice Filtrate – 10,000ppm of rice filtrate helps to hydrate and clarify the skin. Sugarcane, Grape, and Apple Extracts – Naturally exfoliates and conditions skin. How To Use Our Wonder Rice Smoothing Toner can be used in multiple ways depending on the type of skin concerns you have! For normal skin- After washing your face, soak a cotton pad with toner and sweep over skin to remove remaining toxins and impurities. Our 5 Layer Cotton Squares are perfect! Gently pat the remaining toner into skin until the product is fully absorbed. Follow up with the rest of your skincare routine! For dry, dehydrated skin- Try the 7-skin method! Pour a small amount of toner into clean, bare hands and gently pat the product into your skin until it's fully absorbed. Repeat the process 7 times to deeply hydrate the skin. Follow up with the rest of your skincare routine! For very dry or combination skin- Soak several cotton pads with toner. Place soaked cotton pads on the face like a sheet mask, focusing on the areas that feel dry (i.e. cheeks, forehead, nose, etc.) Let the toner soak into your skin for 10 minutes, then remove the pads. Gently pat the remaining toner into the skin until the product is fully absorbed. Follow up with the rest of your skincare routine!
